summary.text: Tony Lovasco is the Republican candidate for the Missouri House of Representatives, District 63, in the November 3, 2026 general election, having advanced from the Republican primary on August 4, 2026.
He previously represented District 64 in the Missouri House from 2019 to 2025.

paragraphs.text: Lovasco assumed office as a Missouri state representative in 2019 and left office on January 8, 2025, when Deanna Self succeeded him in District 64.
In 2023 and 2024 he was assigned to the House General Laws Committee, the Downsizing State Government Committee, the House Ways and Means Committee and the Joint Committee on Tax Policy.
In earlier terms, from 2019 through 2022, he served on the Ways and Means and Downsizing State Government committees.
